newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer arrives at finance ministry in Bonn.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer arrives at finance ministry in Bonn.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer arrived at the Finance Ministry in Bonn on Tuesday for a meeting with Finance Minister Theo Waigel, eyewitnesses said.
Juergen Koppelin, a member of parliament for the Free Democrats (FDP), said in HR radio that the discussions centred on Waigel's plans to revalue Bundesbank gold and currency reserves.

The Finance Ministry and the Bundesbank declined to comment. A meeting between the two men had been considered in recent days but there had been no official announcement about when or where they would meet.
